in_hebrew.name: Orran
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Orran הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'oros' meaning mountain. In ancient Greek culture, mountains were seen as divine and powerful symbols. The name Orran is a strong and robust name for a boy, reflecting the strength and power of nature.
